items.title: Hackers Hijacked French Blood Plasma Freezers, Changing Temperature Settings From −30°C to 110°C
items.description: Hackers reportedly changed temperature settings on refrigeration equipment used by the French Blood Establishment, EFS, from around −30°C to 110°C after targeting its cooling service provider, Coolworld. The incident occurred overnight between November 1 and 2, 2026, raising concerns about frozen plasma stored for patient transfusions. According to reporting published by Cyberattaque citing Le…

items.title: Philippine Migrant Worker Data Likely Leaked in 69GB Government Breach
items.description: An unknown operator appears to have exfiltrated SQL Server backups from the Philippine Overseas Employment Administration in under a half hour.
